notes:
v4.6.96 — Big lag/freeze fix + cloud bots re-attach after a crash/update

⚡ LAG & FREEZES (starting bots / switching to IBKR)
• Each bot tab has ~7 charts, and each chart was a full embedded web view (Chromium). With several bots the app built 30+ web views up front — so startup, every broker switch (all tabs rebuilt), and every refresh churned them. Charts are now LAZY: a chart’s web view is created only when you actually open that bot’s tab, and hidden tabs just cache their latest data at near-zero cost.
• The refresh loop no longer regenerates every bot tab’s charts each cycle — only the OVERVIEW and the tab you’re looking at refresh; other bot tabs refresh the moment you open them.

☁ CLOUD BOTS AFTER A CRASH / UPDATE
• After the desktop crashes or updates, your Oracle bots keep trading — but the app sometimes showed them as stopped (a failed status re-check), which could make you stop a bot that was actually running. The app now retries the status re-attach for ~1 min so a bot still trading on Oracle correctly shows as running.

Note: if a bot truly isn’t restarting at the market open on the server side, that’s a separate server check — tell me and we’ll look at the Oracle gateway logs.

Update via the in-app banner.
